sql: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at)::date::text AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='rejected' AND cancel_reason LIKE '%user_not_found%') AS user_not_found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='rejected') AS rejected_any, count(*) AS orders FROM live_orders WHERE created_at > now() - interval '20 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
